title: Godot crashes with ERROR: Attempting to use an uninitialized RID at: get_or_null (./core/templates/rid_owner.h:247)`
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible: 4.7.stable.official (https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/5b4e0cb0fd279832bbdd69fed5354d4e5ad26f88), macOS 15.7.9, Apple M2 (Metal, Mobile renderer) and --headless.
Linux x86_64 ;  4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf  
Linux x86_64 ;  4.5.stable.official.876b29033    
Linux x86_64;  4.4.1.stable.official.49a5bc7b6 

### System information

macOS 15.7.9 (24G830), Mac14,15 (M2, 8 GB). Godot 4.7.stable.official (5b4e0cb); 4.7.1.stable.official.a13da4feb  

### Issue description

GodotPhysicsServer2D::free_rid(body) asks shape_owner.owns() first
    (modules/godot_physics_2d/godot_physics_server_2d.cpp:1224); it answers true,
    shape_owner.get_or_null() returns null, and the shape branch uses it.

### Steps to reproduce

  1. Unzip rid_validator_wrap_repro.zip (project.godot and repro.gd, nothing else).
  2. godot --headless --path rid_validator_wrap_repro --script res://repro.gd
  3. Optional: "-- control" spends one more id before body_create(): body 0x1, frees, exit 0.
     "-- natural" makes no rid_allocate_id() call: the counter moves only by creating and freeing
     circle shapes (PhysicsServer2D.circle_shape_create / free_rid). Same crash.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[rid_validator_wrap_repro.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33613325/rid_validator_wrap_repro.zip)
